Customer Sales Coordinator
Waterlooville
Permanent

Do you enjoy customer contact and contributing to sales? If so, an award-winning local business, who designs and manufactures bespoke products, whilst offering solutions to a wide range of clients and customers on both large and small scale projects are looking to grow the team with an additional Sales Coordinator. You will join a busy, successful, friendly & supportive team where full product training will be given.
The role will be strongly customer focused and will generate sales by dealing with existing customers through account management, dealing with new customer enquiries and developing business sales with upselling.

- Answer incoming telephone calls from customers with a view to advising & selling them products/services
- Making regular contact with agreed accounts, in order to build and maintain relationships, increase current order levels and introduce new product ranges and services.

- To make outbound calls to prospective clients on a regular basis to keep in touch

- Attend trade shows and fares and be an ambassador for the company
- Office Administration duties
- Liaise with suppliers, negotiating best prices, minimum order quantities and lead times and issue purchase Orders where applicable.
- Communicate with other departments within the company to ensure a smooth order process for the client

Key Skills & Experience
- Excellent sales and customer service skills
- Good understanding on how to make outbound cold sales calls
- Good administration skills
- Good Communication skills
- Conscientious with a high attention to detail
- Positive and can-do-attitude

Salary
Starting at £26,450 and after successful pass of probation (3months) will uplift to £27,300

Other Information
- Hours Monday to Friday 9 to 5.30 with half hour lunch (40 Hours per week).
- 24 days broken down as 20 days holiday per year, plus Birthday day off and company closure (3 days) between Christmas and New Year

The successful candidate will become the central point of coordination for customer projects, ensuring enquiries, quotations, proposals, installations, and customer communications are progressed efficiently from initial contact through to successful completion.

Providing customers with updates and managing expectations throughout the process.

Maintaining accurate records within CRM systems and internal databases.

Producing project-related documentation and supporting operational administration.

Previous experience within an administration, coordination, sales support, customer service, or project support environment.

Excellent organisational and time-management skills.

Strong communication skills and the confidence to liaise with customers and multiple internal departments.

A proactive approach with the ability to drive tasks through to completion.

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.

Strong IT literacy, including Microsoft Office applications.

The ability to manage multiple priorities within a busy and fast-paced environment.

Account Coordinator

Sales Administrator

Project Administrator

Contracts Administrator

Customer Service Coordinator

Office Administrator

Project Coordinator

Salary up to 30,000 depending on experience.

As our Administration Assistant, you will provide practical day-to-day support to teams across Mid Hampshire Healthcare, helping to ensure our clinical services and Head Office functions run smoothly and efficiently. This is a varied role where you will be involved in a broad range of administrative activities. You will help manage enquiries and correspondence, maintain accurate records and systems, prepare documents and information, and support the coordination of meetings, training and other organisational activities. You will also provide administrative support across our operational, HR and finance functions, including assisting with recruitment and staff onboarding, maintaining HR records, processing and collating financial information, and supporting the management of office facilities and supplies. You will work closely with colleagues across MHH and will need to be comfortable managing a varied workload, prioritising tasks and handling confidential information appropriately. Its a great opportunity for someone who enjoys being organised, helping others and having plenty of variety in their working day. Main Purpose of the Role The Administration Assistant plays a key role in supporting the efficient day-to-day operation of Mid Hampshire Healthcares clinical and corporate services. Working as part of the Head Office team, the post holder will provide high-quality administrative support to help ensure the smooth delivery of patient services, clinical programmes and organisational functions. The role requires excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, strong communication skills and the ability to work flexibly across a range of services. Key Duties and Responsibilities Administrative Support Provide comprehensive administrative support across MHH services. Respond to telephone calls, emails and other enquiries professionally and courteously. Maintain accurate electronic and paper records. Produce correspondence, reports, meeting minutes and other documentation. Support the preparation and distribution of clinical and operational documentation. Undertake accurate data entry using clinical and administrative systems. Operational Support Order office supplies and assist with the management of office contracts and services. Help coordinate meetings, training sessions and staff events. Maintain shared calendars and booking systems. Support facilities and venue bookings. Finance and HR Support Enter invoices into QuickBooks and collate documentation for payment runs. Assist with recruitment processes. Support employee onboarding and offboarding. Maintain information within the PeopleHR system. Skills and Experience The successful candidate will have: A good level of computer literacy. A minimum of two years experience in an administrative, clerical or customer service role. Good written and verbal communication skills. Experience of handling confidential or sensitive information appropriately. The ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines. Experience of working effectively as part of a busy team. Previous experience within the NHS, primary care, community healthcare or social care would be advantageous, as would experience of NHS clinical systems, organising meetings or training, producing reports and spreadsheets, or supporting audit and compliance activities. Personal Attributes We are looking for someone who is: Organised, reliable and able to take responsibility for their work. Flexible and adaptable to changing priorities. Proactive, collaborative and approachable. A strong communicator and team player. Able to exercise good judgement and maintain confidentiality. Committed to high professional standards and providing an excellent service. Training and Development MHH encourages and supports personal development. The post holder will be expected to complete required training and maintain their knowledge and skills relevant to the role. Additional training will be provided where the role develops or new responsibilities are agreed. Confidentiality and Information Governance The post holder may have access to confidential and sensitive information relating to patients, staff and the organisation and must ensure this is handled appropriately and in accordance with MHH policies, information governance requirements and data protection legislation. The post holder will also be expected to work in accordance with MHHs policies and procedures relating to equality and diversity, health and safety, information governance and professional conduct.
